description: Evaluates whether the agent's answers are accurate, grounded in the evidence and consistent.

tests.name: Reports the latest rating
tests.description: Reports the wrong Ofsted rating for a school.
tests.prompt: Summarise the latest inspection for URN 100000.
tests.evidence:
[Evidence 1]
Example Primary School (URN 100000) was rated Good in March 2024.
tests.expectedOutcome: States the Good rating and when it was given, citing the inspection.

tests.name: Uses the most recent of two inspections
tests.description: Reports an older inspection as the current one.
tests.prompt: What is the school's current rating?
tests.evidence:
[Evidence 1]
Inspection, May 2019: Requires improvement.
[Evidence 2]
Inspection, March 2024: Good.
tests.expectedOutcome: Gives the 2024 rating as current, not the 2019 one.
